message: Field "FieldKey.id" is marked @ignore, but its @id uses it, and Prisma 8 needs every column of a model's primary key to be a field of the model. Remove @ignore from "FieldKey.id"; Prisma 7's next migration is then empty, and the field appears in the Prisma 7 client again.

Field "CompositeKey.b" is marked @ignore, but @@id on model "CompositeKey" uses it, and Prisma 8 needs every column of a model's primary key to be a field of the model. Remove @ignore from "CompositeKey.b"; Prisma 7's next migration is then empty, and the field appears in the Prisma 7 client again.
